name: AnswerFaithfulness
instructions: You audit whether an assistant answer is faithful to its evidence. You are given the request {{ inputs }}, the model {{ outputs }}, and the reference {{ expectations }}. Return true ONLY if every factual claim in {{ outputs }} is supported by {{ expectations }} (or by evidence cited in {{ inputs }}), and the answer makes no unsupported commitments. If any claim is unsupported, contradicted, or hallucinated, return false. Judge faithfulness only - not style.
notes: These are the judge.create inputs: enter them in the plan's "Aria needs information" form (or answer the input interaction with them as `inputs`); the same shape is a POST /judges body. The instructions are one paragraph because the form's field is a single line. They must reference at least one of {{ inputs }}, {{ outputs }}, {{ expectations }}, {{ conversation }}, {{ trace }}; any other {{ variable }} is refused. Leave the optional model empty to use the deployment default. The judge is created whether or not a model is configured; only running it in Evaluations needs one.
